const key = "__@computed";
const token = Symbol("token");

type Dict = { [key: `__@${string}`]: number };
const dict: Dict = { "__@hello": 1, [key]: 2, get "__@accessor"() { return 3; } };
const either: Dict | { spare?: boolean } = { "__@hello": 4 };
const eitherGetter: Dict | { spare?: boolean } = { get [key]() { return 5; } };

interface Mixed {
  [key: `__@${string}`]: (value: string) => number;
  [key: symbol]: (value: number) => string;
}
const mixed: Mixed = {
  ["__@length"](value) { return value.length; },
  [token](value) { return value.toFixed(); },
};

const arbitrary: string = "extra";
const spread = { [arbitrary]: 6, "__@member": 7, [token]: "symbol" };
const numeric: Record<string, number> = { ...spread };

console.log(dict["__@hello"], dict[key], dict["__@accessor"], "__@hello" in either, key in eitherGetter);
console.log(mixed["__@length"]("abc"), mixed[token](42), numeric["__@member"]);
